title: From Evaluation to Defense: Advancing Safety in Video Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Defense Success Rate (DSR) of Video LLMs against multimodal video-query pairs designed to solicit hate speech, racial discrimination, and ethnic attacks, using an LLM-as-a-judge (Qwen-Long) to classify responses as safely refused or unsafe.

Evaluating the Defense Success Rate (DSR) of Video LLMs against multimodal video-query pairs designed to solicit gender discrimination and misogynistic speech, using an LLM-as-a-judge (Qwen-Long) to classify responses as safely refused or unsafe.

Evaluating the Defense Success Rate (DSR) of Video LLMs against multimodal video-query pairs designed to solicit homophobic speech and hate towards sexual minorities, using an LLM-as-a-judge (Qwen-Long) to classify responses as safely refused or unsafe.

Evaluating the Defense Success Rate (DSR) of Video LLMs against multimodal video-query pairs designed to solicit religious hatred and persecution, using an LLM-as-a-judge (Qwen-Long) to classify responses as safely refused or unsafe.

Evaluating the Defense Success Rate (DSR) of Video LLMs against multimodal video-query pairs designed to solicit anti-immigrant sentiment and xenophobia, using an LLM-as-a-judge (Qwen-Long) to classify responses as safely refused or unsafe.
